thread:
ashley: Quick FYI — tenant_id type-change migration scheduled tonight 23:30 PT in the maintenance slot.
ashley: Window 30m; plan is backfill + FK validate. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/tenantid-type-change (please review).
dan: Can we pin the service to v1.12.3 for the window? Avoids new bigint parsing path.
ashley: Yes. I will pin the deploy and create a holdpoint in the deploy runbook.
deploy-bot: [scheduled] deploy tag redwood/service@v1.12.3 to prod will start at 23:30 PT (2412346789).
maria: I can take lock owner for the first 10m. infra-oncall, please be ready to take over at +10m if needed.
priya: Preflight checks done: dry-run on staging passed; schema cast plan looks clean for sample subset.
ashley: Rollout steps (high level):
- pin service -> v1.12.3
- run schema migration: `ALTER TABLE tenants ALTER COLUMN id TYPE bigint USING id::bigint;`
- kick off backfill jobs (shards 0..31)
- run `ALTER TABLE ... VALIDATE CONSTRAINT` / FK validate
- unpin after 5m steady
dan: If per-row time >3s, pause and fallback to canary-by-shard. Don't let full-table lock persist.
maria: I have monitoring: DB CPU, tokio-latency, and migration-row-rate alerts.
priya: Release notes excerpt: 
``
Breaking change: tenant.id type changes from int -> bigint. Service v1.12.3 contains compatibility shim.
Rollback: revert service pin to v1.12.2, stop backfill jobs, and run rollback job if a partial cast occurred.
```
dan: Rollback plan reviewed. DB owner must sign off before any reverse-cast.
ashley: Abort criteria: table-level lock >120s, or >5% error rows in a shard. If abort, follow the escape-hatch below.
maria: Escape-hatch (abort) steps:
1) stop backfill jobs: `kubectl -n datajobs delete job backfill-tenantid-*`
2) pin service back to v1.12.2
3) notify infra-oncall and open incident channel
4) gather diagnostic dump: `pg_stat_activity` + slow queries
5) cut a postmortem and schedule safe window reattempt
priya: Added the checklist to the release doc and set the doc lock for edits.
deploy-bot: [started] migration job tenantid-type-change at 23:30 PT (2412346795).
maria: Lock acquired on tenants (owner=maria) :lock: expected hold ~8m.
dan: Observability: p95 latency +0.6s but within SLOs so far :eyes:.
priya: Backfill shard 0/32 completed.
maria: Stuck row detected in shard 7, tried single-row repair but it blocks; pausing shard 7 and raising ticket.
ashley: Decision: pause overall backfill. We're going to abort main run and revert service pin to mitigate risk. Maria, execute abort steps.
maria: Stopping jobs and reverting pin now.
deploy-bot: [reverted] service pinned to v1.12.2 (2412346870).
schema-bot: [postmortem-draft] created draft: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-8891
dan: Good call. Logged action items in the release doc; we'll reconvene tomorrow for a safer window with smaller shards.
ashley: Thanks team — nice coordination. :thumbsup:
